name: Retrieved Instruction and Data Separation
mechanism: Labels, delimits and bounds retrieved material as untrusted evidence and prevents it from directly supplying system instructions, credentials, tool authority or canonical memory writes.
use_when: External or user-controlled content enters the model context
Retrieved evidence may influence tools or memory
avoid_when: The generator cannot preserve message roles or content boundaries
The application treats delimiters as a complete prompt-injection defense
expected_effects: Explicit trust boundary between application instructions and evidence
Bounded exposure to context flooding and indirect injection
failure_modes: The model follows malicious text despite delimiters
Tool parameters are copied from evidence without policy review
